normalization: Only chunk hash filenames and bundler region/source-map comments differ between source locations. All 14 JS files otherwise match exactly.
acceptedChanges: Match Drizzle setup between package and manual JSON-mode workers.
Match ESM/CJS module formats by default and report chosen formats.
Record pre-export setup memory and its high-water mark separately.
Support isolated single-export/diagnostic workers without changing the package API.

validation.outputChecks: All variants/manual/module formats in each cohort match plain CSV and ZIP hashes. Plain hashes also match independently generated fixture CSV.

reliabilityNote: An initial suite run alongside fixture preparation failed the existing Turso early-abort session-count assertion. The isolated 84-test Turso run and full 469-test rerun passed with no runtime/test changes. Both initial and rerun logs are retained.
limits: All performance measurements use local SQLite and counting Node destinations, not live Turso or HTTP delivery.
Whole-process RSS includes startup and repeated exports; setup peaks cannot simply be subtracted to obtain precise incremental CSV memory.
Profiles are diagnostic and are not the release timing comparison.
The three-round candidate screens are exploratory; only the 128-row candidate received the five-round matched recheck.
No global GC hooks, buffer detachment/reuse, adaptive sizing or extra SQL requests were introduced.
